mapper.select: SELECT P.id, P.member_id, P.category, P.title, M.name AS author, P.content, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM community_comment C WHERE C.post_id = P.id AND C.status = 'ACTIVE') AS replies, P.view_count AS views, P.view_count, P.like_count, P.status, P.created_at, P.updated_at FROM community_post P, member M WHERE P.member_id = M.id AND P.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY P.created_at DESC, P.id DESC

SELECT P.id, P.member_id, P.category, P.title, M.name AS author, P.content, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM community_comment C WHERE C.post_id = P.id AND C.status = 'ACTIVE') AS replies, P.view_count AS views, P.view_count, P.like_count, P.status, P.created_at, P.updated_at FROM community_post P, member M WHERE P.member_id = M.id AND P.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_post ( member_id, category, title, content, status ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.update: UPDATE community_post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE community_post SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT C.id, C.post_id, C.member_id, M.name AS author, C.content, C.status, C.created_at, C.updated_at FROM community_comment C, member M WHERE C.member_id = M.id AND C.post_id = #{postId} AND C.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY C.created_at, C.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_comment ( post_id, member_id, content, status ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.update: UPDATE community_comment SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_report ( post_id, reporter_member_id, reason, detail, status ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{reporterMemberId}, #{reason}, #{detail}, 'PENDING' )
